task_completion.description: Log into the SEB Server using super-admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the SEB Server dashboard or home page after the login screen, indicating successful authentication.

task_completion.description: Create a new exam configuration named 'French 305 Midterm'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text input field or a header showing the name 'French 305 Midterm' within the exam configuration creation/edit view.

task_completion.description: Disable both 'Allow Spell Check' and 'Allow Grammar Check' settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Checkboxes or toggles for 'Allow Spell Check' and 'Allow Grammar Check' must be in the unchecked or 'Off' state.
A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow Dictionary Search' must be in the checked or 'On' state.

task_completion.description: Set the main browser language to French ('fr' or 'fr-FR').
task_completion.visual_evidence: A language selection dropdown or text field showing 'fr' or 'fr-FR' as the configured browser language.

task_completion.description: Save the changes to the exam configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicking a 'Save', 'Create', or 'Submit' button, followed by a success message or the configuration appearing in the list.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than terminal commands to modify the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser at http://localhost:8080, not SQL commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the SEB Server menus to find the correct settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the agent clicking through the SEB Server UI tabs (e.g., Exams, Settings) to reach the configuration page.

integrity.description: The agent did not use pre-written scripts to automate the API calls.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent manually interacting with the UI elements (toggles, text fields) rather than just a single script execution.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The exam name must be exactly 'French 305 Midterm'. The specific settings required are: Spell Check = Disabled (False), Grammar Check = Disabled (False), Dictionary Search = Enabled (True), and Browser Language = 'fr' or 'fr-FR'. Credentials for login are super-admin / admin.
